main_measure.name: t of the daily-summed forecast/10 x excess next-bar return on Friday-close trending cases

statistic.name: t of the mean across days

main_measure.threshold: t of 2 or more confirms (with top-minus-bottom above 0); t of -2 or less rejects; at least 200 distinct Friday days

supporting_check.name: Saturday excess return, top third minus bottom third of forecast (Welch t 4.951)

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom difference is above 0.
reading: Cases are all Friday-start bars with regime 'trending' and a next bar in the same window (forecast 0 included), the coin's mean is its mean next-bar return over all windows, the thirds are the lowest and highest floor(n/3) cases pooled across coins by forecast (stable sort), and only the 200-day minimum is applied as a hard count since the 2,000 coin-cases is stated as 'about'.
